title: jQuery Quick Guide
description: Find a short explanation and a worked example for each idea in the jQuery course.

entries.name: Select a page part
entries.summary: The jQuery function, often written $, selects page elements using a CSS selector.

entries.name: Set plain text
entries.summary: The text method reads or replaces text. A replacement is treated as words rather than HTML markup.

entries.name: Add and remove classes
entries.summary: A class name lets CSS handle the appearance.

entries.name: Respond to a click
entries.summary: The on method adds an event handler. It can run a function whenever the chosen element receives that event.

entries.name: Read a typed value
entries.summary: The val method reads the current value of a form control.

entries.name: Read a checkbox state
entries.summary: The prop method reads a live element property.

entries.name: Find a nearby parent
entries.summary: closest walks up from an element until it finds a matching ancestor or the element itself.

entries.name: Append a safe new item
entries.summary: You can create an element and set its text before adding it to a list.

entries.name: Handle future child buttons
entries.summary: A delegated handler is attached to a parent and checks matching child elements.

entries.name: Remove only your handler
entries.summary: Event namespaces let you label handlers for later cleanup.

entries.name: Load a local JSON file
entries.summary: getJSON makes a request for JSON data. done handles success, while fail handles a failed request.

entries.name: Compare with the standard DOM
entries.summary: Many small jQuery jobs also have built-in browser equivalents.
